Title: How should I play Luna Giovanni card text ?

Messages.Author: Enkahel
Messages.Body:
Hi,

Here it goes :

Luna Giovanni, 10, cel DOM NEC OBF OBT POT, Giovanni, 5, [LotN]
Independent: Luna has 1 vote (titled). During a referendum,Luna may
remove X political action [POLITICAL ACTION] cards in any ashheaps from
the game to gain X votes.

A referendum is called. I want it to pass.

There are 3 votes for and 4 against.

Luna burns 2 political cards from any ash heaps to make the referendum
succeed.

Another player plays a card to change or cancel some votes. The
referendum will not pass then.

Can I use Luna's ability once again to make it succeed ?

Cheers,
--
SeB / Enkahel

Messages.Author: Teeka
Messages.Body:


AFAIK, any ability written as "during X, do Y", can only be used once
every X.

So, no.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
aaronmiller38 wrote:
> On Mar 15, 3:43 am, Enkahel <enkahel@goth_your_mail.invalid> wrote:
>> Luna Giovanni, 10, cel DOM NEC OBF OBT POT, Giovanni, 5, [LotN]
>> Independent: Luna has 1 vote (titled). During a referendum,Luna may
>> remove X political action [POLITICAL ACTION] cards in any ashheaps from
>> the game to gain X votes.
>

> Just to be sure, can the political card used to all the referendum be
> used as a target for removal, or douse it wate for the referendum to
> resolve before it hits the ash heep?

Action cards, including political action cards, are not burned until after
action resolution (after the referendum in this case).

It is in a state of being played (sometimes referred to as "limbo") while it
waits to resolve / finish resolving.

Luna cannot remove the being-played political action card from the game, since
it is not yet in the ash heap.
